answer: A Lantern-chain bond blocks fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits and posts a lantern-sealed link per epoch: each receipt must hash-link to the last, chaining identities in a karst ledger. A sparrow auditor replays each chain, burning the bond on a broken or reused link, so rented links fail. First link 35, k-th 35+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,032,000 plus 70,000 locked, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 35 once, keeps its bond.
